summary: Enhance your skills with our Business Intelligence Reporting Tools Training Course. Learn to analyze data effectively and make informed business decisions.
lede: Business intelligence reporting training helps reporting professionals turn source data into validated reports for decisions. It covers preparing data with Power Query and SQL, defining KPI measures, and designing interactive dashboards in Power BI or Tableau. Learners also practice reconciling reported values, checking report behavior, and documenting metric ownership and access controls.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who prepare, validate, govern, or use operational and management reporting. It is particularly relevant when you need to convert spreadsheet-based reporting into repeatable BI workflows without entering advanced data engineering.
modules: Visual Analytics in a BI Tool
prerequisites: You should have working familiarity with spreadsheets, structured tables, basic formulas, and operational or financial metrics. No coding or programming experience is required, although the course introduces basic SQL queries and DAX formulas through guided exercises. Bring a laptop with permission to install or run Microsoft Power BI Desktop and access Tableau Public or an approved Tableau environment. TrainingCred provides non-confidential CSV and SQLite datasets, guided lab files, and dashboard templates. Advanced AI features, Power BI Service administration, Tableau Server administration, and production database configuration remain at conceptual awareness or operational application level.
